title: Ask, clarify, decide
pedagogy: No new vocabulary. Connect a location question to a direction answer, then a market price question to a bargaining request. Reuse units 1–10 words plus the two direction words introduced in out-01. Contrast left/right and ordering/asking-price intentions. Preserve all original wordId tone derivations. Sentence building moves from meaning to audio before contextual reply choices.

exercises.title: Carry the meaning into the next turn
body: A conversation is more than recognizing each sentence. Use the answer you just heard to decide what to say next.
First ask for directions. Then visit the market, check a price, and ask for a reduction. These are familiar words doing several jobs together.

exercises.explanation: The destination comes first, followed by อยู่ที่ไหน and the polite ending.

exercises.thai: ตรงไปแล้วเลี้ยวซ้ายครับ
exercises.rtgs: trong pai laeo liao sai khrap

choices.thai: ตรงไปแล้วเลี้ยวซ้ายครับ
choices.rtgs: trong pai laeo liao sai khrap
choices.meaning: Go straight, then turn left. (male speaker)

choices.thai: เลี้ยวซ้ายครับ

exercises.explanation: แล้ว connects two instructions. Keep both steps, rather than stopping after ตรงไป.

exercises.meaning: Go straight, then turn left. (male speaker)
exercises.explanation: ซ้าย is left. ขวา would send the person in the other direction.

exercises.context: A passer-by has just explained the route to the bathroom. You are a man and want to thank him before following it.

speaker.thai: ตรงไปแล้วเลี้ยวซ้ายครับ
speaker.rtgs: trong pai laeo liao sai khrap

exercises.question: What do you say next?

choices.thai: ขอบคุณครับ
choices.note: Thank him for the directions, then follow the two steps.

choices.thai: เท่าไหร่ครับ
choices.note: This asks a price; the passer-by has given directions.

choices.thai: ขอข้าวครับ
choices.note: This orders rice, which belongs in a different scene.

exercises.meaning: How much is this one? (male speaker)
exercises.gloss: thing + this + how-much + male polite particle
exercises.explanation: At the market, อันนี้ points to the item and เท่าไหร่ asks its price.

exercises.meaning: Can you lower it a bit? (male speaker)
exercises.explanation: ลด asks to lower the price. Keep หน่อยได้ไหมครับ as the request ending.

exercises.context: At a market stall, you ask the price. You are a man who wants to ask for a reduction, not accept or decline yet.

speaker.thai: สามสิบห้าบาท

exercises.question: What do you say next?

choices.thai: ลดหน่อยได้ไหมครับ
choices.note: ลดหน่อยได้ไหมครับ asks whether the vendor can lower the price.
This accepts the item at this stage, without asking for a reduction.
This declines the item and uses a female ending; you want to negotiate.

exercises.meaning: Can you lower it a bit? (male speaker)
exercises.gloss: lower + softener + can + question particle + male polite particle
exercises.explanation: Listen and rebuild the complete request.

exercises.context: The vendor agrees to your requested price. You are a man and now want to accept the item.
exercises.question: What do you say next?

choices.note: เอาครับ accepts the item after the vendor agrees.

choices.thai: ห้องน้ำอยู่ที่ไหนครับ
choices.rtgs: hong nam yu thi nai khrap
choices.note: This asks for the bathroom, leaving the purchase unfinished.
